issue.title: Show a read-only 'quiet for N min' stall hint on running agent rows
issue.description:
Proposed by land phase sase-1qz.11 (note #2) of epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack, plan:202611/agent_hijack.md), which deferred a stall hint.

Agent Hijack gives the user a way to stop a stalled agent and keep its work, but nothing tells them an agent has stalled. Shape: a read-only, dim "quiet for N min" hint on RUNNING rows whose last tool call or transcript write is older than a threshold, derived from data the TUI already loads off the event loop (tool-call ledger, last activity). It must never change lifecycle state, buckets, or trigger a hijack automatically.

task_type_fields.proposal: Render a dim, read-only 'quiet for N min' hint on RUNNING rows whose last tool or transcript activity is older than a threshold, without changing status, buckets, or triggering any action.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The hijack epic covered stopping and recovering, not detecting stalls; the plan explicitly excluded stall_detection_seconds and deferred the hint.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1qz's land phase (sase-1qz.11) deferred a stall hint; hijack exists to stop stalled agents but nothing flags that an agent has stalled.
